subject: Matt
note: Reply bench cases (2026-11-09, KI-106): does the phone's prompt make the on-device model answer a statement as a friend and a question from its memories? Each case is one message with the memories recall would have found (`memories`, content plus how many days ago it was stored) and, where it matters, the turns before it (`history`). Kinds and how they are scored, case-insensitive: `statement` must contain none of the lookup phrases (the default `must_not` list in reply_bench.rs: 'don't have', 'no record', 'stored', 'want me to remember', 'remember now'...); `recall` must contain every entry of `must` (an entry 'a|b' is satisfied by either); `missing` must say it does not have the detail and, with `no_digits`, must carry no number; `web` must contain WEB_SEARCH_NEEDED; `nosearch` must not. `{weekday}` in a `must` entry is the run day's weekday. Synthetic facts chosen not to collide with anything in the testers' own memories: no cats, no Vermont, no family addresses.
